comments.author: marina-costa
comments.body: Five digits cover one neighborhood in São Paulo, but in the countryside they span different towns. Have we measured the shipping difference within the same prefix?

comments.author: pedro-alves
comments.body:
I measured 30 days of quotes: within the same prefix, **97%** had the same price.

I put the other 3% as a trade-off in the description. If that is too much, we can use 8 digits and accept fewer cache hits.
